import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from notes.app import DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, app


@pytest.fixture
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("NOTES_DB", str(tmp_path / "notes.db"))
    return TestClient(app)


def _make(client, n, tags=()):
    return [client.post("/notes", json={"title": f"n{i}", "body": "b", "tags": list(tags)}).json()["id"] for i in range(n)]


def test_default_page_size_and_cursor(client):
    _make(client, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE + 5)
    first = client.get("/notes")
    assert len(first.json()) == DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
    cursor = first.headers["X-Next-Cursor"]
    second = client.get("/notes", params={"after": cursor})
    assert len(second.json()) == 5
    assert "X-Next-Cursor" not in second.headers


def test_walks_every_note_exactly_once(client):
    ids = _make(client, 23)
    seen, cursor = [], None
    while True:
        r = client.get("/notes", params={"limit": 5, **({"after": cursor} if cursor else {})})
        seen += [n["id"] for n in r.json()]
        cursor = r.headers.get("X-Next-Cursor")
        if not cursor:
            break
    assert seen == ids


def test_tag_filter_is_applied_before_paging(client):
    _make(client, 10, tags=["other"])
    wanted = _make(client, 3, tags=["x"])
    r = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "x", "limit": 2})
    assert [n["id"] for n in r.json()] == wanted[:2]
    rest = client.get("/notes", params={"tag": "x", "limit": 2, "after": r.headers["X-Next-Cursor"]})
    assert [n["id"] for n in rest.json()] == wanted[2:]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("params", [{"limit": 0}, {"limit": 201}, {"after": -1}])
def test_rejects_bad_params(client, params):
    assert client.get("/notes", params=params).status_code == 422
